instruction: A clean studio photograph with a full-length profile shot captures two martial artists sparring against a plain white wall in a minimalist indoor setting. On the left, the girl with a ponytail and a blue belt (R2) lunges forward in a deep stance, extending her right fist in a straight punch. On the right, the girl with braided hair and a red belt (R1) stands in a defensive posture, leaning back slightly to block the incoming strike. Both girls wear white karate uniforms and are barefoot on the light floor, focused entirely on their partner. The scene is illuminated by bright, even, diffused studio lighting that eliminates harsh shadows, creating a clean and bright aesthetic with sharp focus on both subjects.
